definitions.gloss: show business; entertainment industry; world of entertainment
definitions.explanation: The professional world of entertainment, including acting, music, comedy, and television. Composed of 芸能 (performing arts) + 界 (world, sphere).

examples.japanese: {芸能界|げいのうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}りたい→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I want to enter show business.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{芸能界|げいのうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引退|いんたい}→引退：01848_intai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She retired from the entertainment world.

examples.japanese: {芸能界|げいのうかい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{華|はな}やか→華やか：06070_hanayaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Show business looks glamorous, but behind the scenes there is fierce competition.

notes:
USAGE:
{芸能界|げいのうかい} refers specifically to the Japanese entertainment industry, including TV, film, music, and comedy. It is very commonly used in media and gossip contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {芸能界|げいのうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (to enter show business)
- {芸能界|げいのうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引退|いんたい}→引退：01848_intai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to retire from show business)
- {芸能界|げいのうかい}⟦デビュー→デビュー：11016_debyuu⟧ (show business debut)
- {芸能界|げいのうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧うわさ (entertainment gossip)

RELATED WORDS:
⟦{芸能人|げいのうじん}→芸能人：14959_geinoujin⟧ means an entertainer or celebrity. ⟦{芸能|げいのう}→芸能：00061_geinou⟧ alone refers to performing arts more broadly.
